inv_txn_acquire_shape.name: inv_txn_acquire_shape
inv_txn_acquire_shape.value: "investment_transactions"."kind" not in ('buy','mf_purchase','transfer_in') or ("investment_transactions"."quantity" > 0 and "investment_transactions"."price" is not null)

inv_txn_dispose_shape.name: inv_txn_dispose_shape
inv_txn_dispose_shape.value: "investment_transactions"."kind" not in ('sell','mf_redemption','transfer_out') or ("investment_transactions"."quantity" < 0 and "investment_transactions"."price" is not null)

inv_txn_ratio_shape.name: inv_txn_ratio_shape
inv_txn_ratio_shape.value: "investment_transactions"."kind" not in ('split','bonus') or ("investment_transactions"."ratio_num" > 0 and "investment_transactions"."ratio_den" > 0 and "investment_transactions"."cash_settled" = false)

inv_txn_income_identity.name: inv_txn_income_identity
inv_txn_income_identity.value:
"investment_transactions"."kind" not in ('dividend','interest')
          or ("investment_transactions"."net_amount_instrument" > 0 and "investment_transactions"."gross_amount" is not null
              and "investment_transactions"."net_amount_instrument" = "investment_transactions"."gross_amount" - "investment_transactions"."fees" - "investment_transactions"."taxes")

inv_txn_transfer_no_cash.name: inv_txn_transfer_no_cash
inv_txn_transfer_no_cash.value:
"investment_transactions"."kind" not in ('transfer_in','transfer_out')
          or ("investment_transactions"."net_amount" = 0 and "investment_transactions"."net_amount_instrument" = 0 and "investment_transactions"."fees" = 0 and "investment_transactions"."taxes" = 0)

inv_txn_corporate_action_shape.name: inv_txn_corporate_action_shape
inv_txn_corporate_action_shape.value:
"investment_transactions"."kind" not in ('split','bonus')
          or ("investment_transactions"."quantity" is null and "investment_transactions"."price" is null and "investment_transactions"."gross_amount" is null
              and "investment_transactions"."net_amount" = 0 and "investment_transactions"."net_amount_instrument" = 0
              and "investment_transactions"."fees" = 0 and "investment_transactions"."taxes" = 0)

inv_txn_ratio_only_on_corporate_actions.name: inv_txn_ratio_only_on_corporate_actions
inv_txn_ratio_only_on_corporate_actions.value: "investment_transactions"."kind" in ('split','bonus') or ("investment_transactions"."ratio_num" is null and "investment_transactions"."ratio_den" is null)
